lib.label: Repo-relative directory of the Angular lib that gets the service (e.g. libs/web/catalog/data-access)

name.label: Service name, dash-case (e.g. order-store); the class is OrderStore

fields.label: Comma-separated state fields as name:type, type string, number, boolean or one of them followed by [] (e.g. count:number,ids:string[]). Each becomes a private writable signal exposed as a readonly signal

folder.label: Folder under src/lib that holds the files, dash-case. Omit to use the name; set it to group related artifacts (e.g. experiments for a service and its directive)

description: New root-provided Angular service with signal state in any Angular lib (data-access and feature libs hold state; a ui lib may carry infrastructure such as the design system's experiments): <lib>/src/lib/<name>/<name>.ts and .spec.ts (no class suffix), exported from the lib barrel. Every field is a private writable signal with a typed initial value, exposed as a readonly signal; methods that change state are written by hand. Not for domain libs. Gives the lib a unit-test target when it has none. Replaces nx g @nx/angular:service.
